```{r}
library(WDI)
```

```{r}
education_indicators <- WDIsearch("education")
head(education_indicators, 100)
```
```{r}
internet_indicators <- WDIsearch("internet")
head(internet_indicators, 100)
```

```{r}
internet_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",                      
  indicator = "IT.NET.USER.ZS",        
  start = 2015,                        
  end = 2019,                           
  extra = TRUE                          
)

head(internet_data)

colnames(internet_data)

internet_data[internet_data$country == "United States", ]
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 2022
data <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = c("IT.NET.USER.ZS", "SE.ADT.LITR.ZS", "SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS"),
  start = 2022,
  end = 2022,
  extra = TRUE
)

# add calculated field
data_clean <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(IT.NET.USER.ZS), !is.na(SE.ADT.LITR.ZS), !is.na(SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS)) %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates")%>%
  mutate(Literacy_Difference = SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS - SE.ADT.LITR.ZS)
  

data_clean
```

```{r}
# Create long-format data for plotting
plot_data <- data_clean %>%
  select(country, IT.NET.USER.ZS, 
         Youth = SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS, 
         Adult = SE.ADT.LITR.ZS) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Youth, Adult), 
               names_to = "Group", 
               values_to = "LiteracyRate")

# Create the scatterplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = IT.NET.USER.ZS, y = LiteracyRate, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(group = country), alpha = 0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Youth" = "red", "Adult" = "green")) +
  labs(
    x = "Internet Usage (% of Population)",
    y = "Literacy Rate (%)",
    color = "Group",
    title = "Internet Usage vs Literacy Rates by Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()r
```

###Plots

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = IT.NET.USER.ZS, y = Literacy_Difference)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, formula = y ~ x) +
  labs(
    x = "Internet Usage (% of Population)",
    y = "Youth − Adult Literacy Rate (%)",
    title = "Internet Access and Generational Literacy Gap (2022)",
    subtitle = "Positive values mean youth literacy exceeds adult literacy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# By region
ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = IT.NET.USER.ZS, y = Literacy_Difference)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  labs(
    x = "Internet Usage (% of Population)",
    y = "Youth − Adult Literacy Rate (%)",
    title = "Literacy Gap vs Internet Usage by Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# By income group
ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = IT.NET.USER.ZS, y = Literacy_Difference)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkgreen") +
  facet_wrap(~ income) +
  labs(
    x = "Internet Usage (% of Population)",
    y = "Youth − Adult Literacy Rate (%)",
    title = "Literacy Gap vs Internet Usage by Income Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

binned <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(bin = ntile(IT.NET.USER.ZS, 5)) %>%
  group_by(income, bin) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_gap = mean(Literacy_Difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_internet = mean(IT.NET.USER.ZS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = IT.NET.USER.ZS, y = Literacy_Difference)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  geom_line(data = binned, aes(x = avg_internet, y = avg_gap), color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = binned, aes(x = avg_internet, y = avg_gap), color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ income) +
  labs(
    x = "Internet Usage (% of Population)",
    y = "Youth − Adult Literacy Rate (%)",
    title = "Generational Literacy Gap vs Internet Access, by Income Group",
    subtitle = "Blue line: linear fit; red points/line: binned average gap"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

###Models


```{r}
nrow(data_clean)  

model <- lm(Literacy_Difference ~ IT.NET.USER.ZS, data = data_clean)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
model1 <- lm(SE.ADT.LITR.ZS ~ IT.NET.USER.ZS, data = data_clean)
summary(model1)
```
```{r}
model2 <- lm(SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS ~ IT.NET.USER.ZS, data = data_clean)
summary(model2)
```
